prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Comparison Matrix New Screen: Adds a detailed comparison matrix screen right after path choice to explain differences between ready-made and custom pets.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "new_path_matrix", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_path_matrix": {"headline": "Choose Your Pet Experience", "body": "Compare pre-made companions versus creating a custom pet.", "layout": "split"}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Pet Persistence Hint: Displays a clear hint below sign-in options clarifying that signing in saves and syncs all pet data safely across sessions.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in ensures your pets and custom creations are securely saved to your account."}}
2: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Compact Selection Layout: Switches the pet pick selection grid to a compact card layout for easier scanning of options.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "compact"}}
3: [home, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Troubleshooting New Screen: Adds a dedicated troubleshooting screen during waiting that helps users verify display settings if the desktop pet fails to show.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_help", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_help": {"headline": "Desktop Display Verification", "body": "If your pet does not appear on screen, check your system tray and overlay permissions.", "layout": "centered"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress Time Estimate Info: Enables visible time estimates and progress indicators on the pet initialization screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true}}
5: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Mascot Stage Redesign: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a stage layout featuring pet confirmation details.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Welcome Your New Companion"}}
6: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Controls Copy Clarification: Updates text on the final onboarding screen to concisely explain primary hotkeys and interaction controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"body": "Your pet is now active on your desktop! Right-click your pet anytime to hide, configure controls, or chat."}}
7: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Generation Help Sub-Flow: Adds a photo validation screen before adoption certification to help users avoid pet rendering issues.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_checker", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_checker": {"headline": "Photo Quality Check", "body": "We check your uploaded image for optimal pet generation.", "layout": "card"}}
8: [choose_path, incentive] Story Screen Mascot Greeting Incentive: Adds an encouraging bonus pet accessory badge preview on the story screen to motivate completion.
   config: {"story": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Unlocks Exclusive Starter Accessory", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [home, notification] Pet Ready Desktop Notification Opt-In: Enables optional desktop notifications on the waiting screen when long pet generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready."}}
